cues.label: HIP
cues.say: Coach: "The punch starts at the hip, not the arm."

cues.label: BACK FOOT
cues.say: Coach: "Heel up. Push the floor away."

cues.label: CHIN
cues.say: Coach: "Chin behind the shoulder the whole way."

watch.fix: The shoulder waits for the hip
watch.label: SHOULDER
watch.say: Coach: "If the shoulder moves first, they see it coming."
